purpose: Elastic uncracked slab-bending predictor with independent vertical displacements, unilateral bearing and pullout ties. First cracking is a domain boundary, not floor failure. No predetermined global outcome.

slab.model: Euler-Bernoulli strip, bilateral axial EA up to first combined extreme-fiber tensile/compressive limit. No reinforcement or postcracking credit. Symmetric 80in pair, equivalent 4.35in rectangular slab from V11A.
slab.mesh_policy: Refine slab only; fixed16-panel steel truss, fixed17 connection stations and fixed32 equivalent-knuckle density. This is a slab discretization check, not actual layout validation.
slab.tensile_strength_status: Uncalibrated explicit assumptions, not an ACI formula or measured WTC concrete tensile strength.
slab.eccentricity_status: Hypothesis: attachment at underside of uniform equivalent slab; actual deck/chord centroid geometry unresolved. Zero-offset diagnostic also tested.
slab.moment_recovery: Uniform signed upward load q: add bubble q*x^2*(x-L)^2/(24EI) to Hermite deflection; M=EI*(Hxx*u-kappa0)+q*(L^2-6Lx+6x^2)/12. Check endpoints and interior M extremum for fiber stress.
slab.load_policy: Apply all80psf reference weight once to slab with consistent distributed-load vector. No extra gravity on steel; reference includes self weight.
slab.temperature_policy: Average of prescribed top/bottom slab temperatures sets E,strength,axial expansion and knuckle table index. kappa0=-alpha*(Ttop-Tbottom)/thickness. Through-depth gradient affects free curvature only; no layered temperature-dependent section analysis.

vertical_connection.stiffness_status: Unmeasured penalty/contact compliance and elastic tie hypotheses. No measured slip-to-failure curve or fracture energy.
vertical_connection.gap_definition: g = slab_vertical - steel_top_vertical, upward positive. g<0 compressive overlap/contact, g>0 opening and tension tie. At zero gap choose compressive tangent only.
vertical_connection.pullout_capacity_source: Reuse V11C verified NCSTAR1-6C Table5-7:15/12/10/7kip per knuckle at concrete20-300/450/600/750C. Linear interpolation hypothesis. No new source PDF scan.
vertical_connection.damage_diagnostic: After first horizontal or vertical tie limit, remove both horizontal slip and vertical tension ties at affected stations; retain unilateral compressive contact. Quasistatic same-load diagnostic only, not fracture dynamics. Stop if slab/member limit earlier.

path_policy: Stop first uncracked concrete criterion, nominal steel/seat criterion or tie limit. No time or fire inferred. Mid-truss imposed motion is an actuator test, not spontaneous impact damage; its reaction/work are included.
